thread:
maria_support: FYI customer 'LatticeWorks' can't see API creds after onboarding. Console shows 'token created' but API returns 403 when they try to call. cc @alex_dev

alex_dev: Can you paste the error? 403 from which endpoint?

maria_support: Here's the curl they ran:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/models --verbose
> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
> {"error":"permission_denied","message":"service account not in project"}
```

samir_oncall: Hmm. Provisioner logs show claim bound to project partner-billing-42, not the customer's project tn-lattice-prod. Might be claim routing bug.

grace_se: Did the provisioning job set 'project_id' label on the service account? I saw that happen with oauth-bound claims.

provisioner-bot: [provisioner] claim tn-9876 created -> SA lattice-tn-9876@redwood-svc. Labels: project=partner-billing-42, env=staging, provisioned_by=provisioner-v2

alex_dev: If SA is labeled to partner project the IAM policy denies when calling customer's org resources. Can you share repro steps and customer tenant id?

maria_support: Tenant: tn-lattice-9876. Steps they followed: sign up -> OIDC handshake -> console shows 'API token created' -> curl with token -> 403. No extra steps.

samir_oncall: Quick triage: run internal sync: `adminctl provisioner rebind --tenant tn-lattice-9876 --target-project tn-lattice-prod` and then trigger `provisioner-sync --force --claim tn-9876`. That should reassign SA and re-propagate roles.

grace_se: Before we run, snapshot current IAM binding and SA metadata:

```
gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy lattice-tn-9876@redwood-svc.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts describe lattice-tn-9876@redwood-svc.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json
```

maria_support: Ran describe, SA has `project: partner-billing-42` in displayName and label. I'll attach the output in support ticket: https://support.redwood/SE-1245

infra_robin: I'm fine to run rebind during low traffic window. ETA 10m. Will take backup of policy.

provisioner-bot: [audit] provisioner-rebind initiated by infra_robin for tenant tn-lattice-9876 at 2026-03-17T16:12Z

infra_robin: Rebind complete. Running sync.

provisioner-bot: [audit] provisioner-sync completed for claim tn-9876. roles bound: roles/redwood.api.access -> lattice-tn-9876@redwood-svc.iam.gserviceaccount.com

maria_support: Customer confirms curl now returns 200. "Thanks — everything works" :tada:

alex_dev: I'll open a small bug to prevent label mapping from using partner project for tenants that have an explicit project mapping. (bug RED-7421)

samir_oncall: Adding follow-up: add unit test for claim routing and add metric to alert if provisioner binds to non-canonical project.

maria_support: Closing support ticket after customer confirmation. Thanks all.
